infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: EClawbot uses the camera when you choose Take Photo in chat or feedback, so you can send a new image to your AI entities or attach a bug-report screenshot.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: EClawbot uses your photo library only when you choose Attach Photo, for example to send an existing image to an AI entity or include screenshots with feedback.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: EClawbot uses the microphone only when you choose to record a voice message for your AI entities.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: EClawbot saves media to your photo library only when you choose to download or save an image from chat or files.
